name: Firebound Sentry — Level-3 Low Priest Fire benchmark foe

identity.focus_feature_notes: Explicit test character with Fire/Conflagration Chosen Conjure Flame Reserved Weapon. Start Accord +1, one of up to 3 legal Prepared Prayers populated. It has NO authored Fire Exaltation; none may be improvised. Built on the legal physical chassis of the merged PR #82 Restorative Vanguard but uses Fire instead of Life.

progression.chosen_devotion: Conjure Flame — Weapon Enchantment, one identified actively wielded sword

defenses.resistance_notes: No Fire Resistance, magical ward or toxin immunity is granted by clothing, Priest Focus or Conjure Flame. Apply ordinary Armor only to physical HP packets.

start_states.condition: No active magic; Conjure Flame requires one 30-AP Projection Action and commits 3 VP before the enhanced hit profile is legal.
The sentry legally established Tier-1 Chosen Reserved Weapon BEFORE combat; sword remains actually wielded; does not receive free recovery after payment.

effects.profile: Weapon Enchantment Primary; one Chosen Devotion Rite instance
effects.required_anchor: The sentry must continuously actually wield the selected sword; one active Chosen self/equipment Rite at level 3.
effects.ending_condition: Immediate end when sword is no longer actually wielded (disarmed/dropped/sheath/stow/handoff), or legal channel release; refund exactly 3 Committed VP if still reserved. Redrawing never restores the effect.

attack_profiles.critical_notes: Natural 20 follows existing confirmation; Strong +1d4, Critical +2d4, Devastating +2d4 and its separately authored wound trigger on the ONE primary sword HP packet before armor. No automatically poisoned weapon.

attack_profiles.critical_notes: One weapon hit and one natural-20 confirmation; bonus critical dice only on physical sword HP (never duplicated on Fire HP or Vigor). Fire packet and Vigor packet occur only on a successful weapon hit. No automatic Burning/Ignite or extra attack.

action_policy: Cold start, Round 1: if permitted, cast Tier-1 Conjure Flame on the sword as the designated Chosen Rite using 30 of 42 Turn AP; the 12 remaining AP cannot pay the 20-AP sword attack. Do not grant a free simultaneous swing.

On later turns with the Reserve active: a legal Low Focus turn may contain at most two 20-AP physical sword attacks (40/42 AP), committed as ONE Attack Sequence per target BEFORE either attack is rolled.
Prepared start: B06-AT-02 may be used on the first real turn if the sword remained actually wielded and the Reservation still exists. No automatic Exaltation attaches to this Fire Rite.
If the sword ceases to be wielded, B06-AT-02 is illegal immediately. B06-AT-01 is legal only when the sword is again legally wielded; no free draw/switch or channel revival.
Defensive TAL-C10 is available if the sentry can legally react and pay it; scenario policy may explicitly freeze that decision for a controlled comparison but must record the omission.
defense_policy: Record each declared incoming Attack Sequence and per-attack Guard/Dodge/Take Hit decisions before rolls; Guard uses sword Defense 17 and at most 3 uses per round.
Dodge starts at Defense 14 and accumulates ordinary +2 Dodge Pressure for each previously chosen Dodge during that round.
Refresh one Reaction, Guard capacity and Dodge Pressure only at actual Round Begin; no free defense refresh from spellcasting.
scenario_constraints: Physical sword HP damage = 3+d6+floor(STR2/2)=4+d6 before target Armor; effective Armor=max(target Armor−Pen2,0); never double-count contribution.
Tier-1 Fire Enchantment: on successful weapon hit Fire HP2 minus explicit Fire Resistance only; Vigor 1+ceil(d6/4) = 2 or 3 direct Vigor (absent authored ward); no automatic toxin exposure.
Use normal targeted defender's Guard/Dodge/Take Hit, critical confirmation, wound/0HP procedure. Profile is NOT an arbitrary guaranteed hit or fixed HP-after-mitigation packet.
No Third attack: Low Level3 Turn AP42 and Physical Attack20 supports exactly two, not three.
Only one current legal Conjure Flame profile per sword; weapon enchant cannot be cast from a non-Fire known repertoire or attach Fire Rider to a mundane attack without the Reserved Weapon.
